title: Crash on 'update' non-resolved async component

labels.name: :hammer: p3-minor-bug
labels.description: Priority 3: this fixes a bug, but is an edge case that only affects very specific usage.

body:
### Vue version

3.4.5

### Link to minimal reproduction

https://play.vuejs.org/#

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the playground

### What is expected?

The text is `AAA data2`, and there is no error message.

### What is actually happening?

The text is `AAA data`, and an error is shown.

### System Info

_No response_

### Any additional comments?

It used to work in preview of pr #7290 .

[The playground of the commit](https://deploy-preview-7290--vue-sfc-playground.netlify.app/#) shows the result correctly.

Probably it is also regressed by [this commit](https://github.com/vuejs/core/commit/0db336ff6c640fb9d3e48943c69f4c1737412be4)
